column3: “Peoples” is rendered “nations”; “from with your God” is rendered “forsaking your God,” and “the hire of a prostitute” “harlots’ earnings.”
NASB supplies “libations of”; “for their self” is rendered “for themselves alone.”
“From the devastation” is rendered “because of destruction”; “nettles will possess their treasure of silver” is rendered “Weeds will take over their treasures of silver.”
NASB adds “this”; “the man of the spirit” is rendered “The inspired man,” and “mad” “demented.”
NASB adds “Yet” and “only”; “animosity” is rendered “hostility.” The structure of the first line is uncertain.
“They have made deep, they have dealt corruptly” is rendered “They have gone deep in depravity.”
“Shame” is rendered “shame” for Baal; “they were detestable things as they loved” is rendered “they became as detestable as that which they loved.”
“From child bearing” is rendered as exclamations, “No birth, no pregnancy, and no conception!”
“From everyone” is rendered “until not a man is left”; NASB adds “indeed.”
“To one who kills” is rendered “for slaughter”; NASB’s “like Tyre … in a pleasant meadow” follows a difficult Hebrew line. The meaning is uncertain.
NASB adds “Indeed” and renders “not I will repeat to love” as “I will love them no more”; “leaders” is rendered “princes.”
